Dear NAAMII Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications & Media Generalist Intern position. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, I am excited about the opportunity to support NAAMII's communications and outreach for programs like the Annual Nepal AI School.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I write SEO-driven content, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using analytics tools. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and AI-optimization techniques to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am comfortable with tools like Canva, Google Analytics, and CMS platforms, and I am eager to apply AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance content production.

I am proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in coordinating multiple tasks. I am particularly drawn to NAAMII's mission to advance research and education in AI, and I believe my skills in content creation, event coordination, and strategic communication would be a valuable asset.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
